explanation.headline: FDA's records show fluoxetine hydrochloride is not on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include fluoxetine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 90 capsules of the 20 mg presentation with 8.7 used per day, giving 10.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 221 capsules of the same presentation with 7.9 used per day, giving 28.1 days on hand.
No public FDA signal has been issued for the plants supplying our current stock.
The rule‑based best option is to buy from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
Its label names no plant we could place, so no FDA inspection classification is available for that source.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
